title: Service Advisor - J. Reopen a completed inspection
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). A line has a completed inspection.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open the line with a completed inspection.
  3. Click Open against the inspection.
expected:
